rules.triggering_proof: The existing typechecker proves the explicit cast preserves the value under its checked specialization consensus.
rules.text_example: redundant `as i32`: a is already i32
counterexamples: conversion required by a parameter type
conversion changes width, signedness, or precision
rules.context: the typechecker's existing specialization consensus and source span

rules.triggering_proof: An existing typed warning site proves the written reference marker is redundant for the resolved call.
rules.text_example: redundant &: ga is passed by reference without it
counterexamples: an explicit reference marker selects a reference parameter
a value parameter requires a value rather than an alias
rules.context: the existing warning node and message

rules.triggering_proof: The existing typechecker proves the construct produces a copy either way, so the explicit reference marker does not avoid it.
rules.text_example: the construct's value is a copy of a either way
counterexamples: copy preserves a snapshot before the source changes
borrowing would not outlive the destination
rules.context: the existing copy warning and source span

rules.triggering_proof: The resolved stdlib::parse_int trailing status result is discarded, unreferenced, or overwritten before inspection in one block.
rules.context: resolved stdlib::parse_int trailing status result; direct use or local binding

rules.triggering_proof: The exact qpoll builtin's received-status result is discarded, unreferenced, or overwritten before inspection in one block.
counterexamples: same-shaped tuple from a non-qpoll API
rules.context: exact qpoll builtin and its trailing received-status result

rules.triggering_proof: A standalone typed literal or constant integer expression has a proven effect-free, nontrapping subtree.
rules.text_example: discarded integer_literal has no observable effect
counterexamples: division by a nonconstant value may trap
nonconstant arithmetic is not proven safe
rules.context: standalone literals and constant integer operations proved nontrapping

rules.triggering_proof: A lexer-recognized suppression directive is malformed, names an unknown rule, duplicates a directive, or matches no finding.
counterexamples: valid reasoned directive matching one finding
directive-like text inside a string is not a comment
a directive attached to a different statement is not stale when matched
rules.context: lexer-recognized directive comments and one-statement binding

rules.triggering_proof: An adjacent signed add/sub assignment and canonical result-versus-source guard use a typed nonnegative right operand.
rules.text_example: signed i8 add is checked after evaluation
rules.context: adjacent typed signed add/sub assignment and result/source comparison

rules.triggering_proof: A same-block full slice is captured, its direct owner grows, and the view is indexed at the owner's current last index.
rules.text_example: slice view keeps its earlier length
rules.context: same-block full slice capture, direct positive growth, and later array.len - 1 index

rules.triggering_proof: At least two distinct function specializations are proven reachable from the selected entry.
rules.context: source function identity and selected entry's reachable specialization contexts
rules.cost: linear specialization table and call graph

rules.triggering_proof: A configured outer API consumes a direct full slice before a later nested call grows the same direct local owner, and uses the view afterward.
rules.text_example: call to contracts::after_append captures a view before a later argument grows
counterexamples: view captured in a later call
rules.context: exact project API roles and direct same-owner nested call arguments
rules.cost: linear call and argument facts plus contract table

rules.triggering_proof: A configured nested index producer and direct local consumer use different direct local array owners.
rules.text_example: call to contracts::use_index consumes an index produced for a different container owner
rules.context: exact project index-producer/consumer roles and direct local-owner identities
rules.cost: linear nested call/argument facts plus contract table
